# Claude Architect Practice

> Free, original, scenario-based practice questions for the Claude Certified Architect – Foundations exam. 8 sets, 120 questions, with an explanation for every answer option. Unofficial and not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Site
- [Practice quiz app](https://thimmapocs-ui.github.io/claude-architect-practice/): interactive practice and exam modes
- [Source repository](https://github.com/thimmapocs-ui/claude-architect-practice): question sets as plain JavaScript files in /sets

## Domains covered
- Agentic Architecture & Orchestration
- Tool Design & MCP Integration
- Claude Code Configuration & Workflows
- Prompt Engineering & Structured Output
- Context Management & Reliability

## Notes
- Questions are original and are not real exam content.
- Verify answers against the official docs at https://docs.claude.com and https://code.claude.com/docs
